content: Yesu buki mutu
Kilumbu kimosi kya sabata, Yesu wisa dya ku nzu ya mosi wa bapfumu ba Bafwadisi, amana bawu bakala musimbulula yi tsikiningi.
Mukwa maladi ma zatu mosi wákala kuna thwala yandi.
Yesu wuhyudi kwena Bafwadisi yi balongi ba mitsiku: «Mitsiku mibati hana muswa ho lo, wa kubuka mutu mu kilumbu kya sabata?»
Kaasi báhwena talala. Hanga wumubongi mbefu, wámubuka amana wámusula kenda.
Kunima, wábazimbwala: «Nati ha kati dya benu, yukani mwana wandi ho lo ngombi wandi kabwa mu buku dimosi, kakonda mulubula yi tswatsu, mu kilumbu kya sabata?»
Kaasi bálendaku kuvutula ku kyufu kina.
Phila ya kusola kifulu yi phila kutedisa
Yesu wáta kingana kwena batu bana bátedisa, kikuma kámona buna bakala sola bifulu bya theti. Kábazimbwala:
«Yukani bakutela, kwena mutu, ku mikinzi mya longu, wendaku dizakadisa ha kifulu kya theti. Hakala nana ni mutu mosi kuhyoki ngeyi mu lukumu kátedisiki;
amana, wuna wulutedisiki benu boodi, kisa kuzimbwala: "Sisila yandi kifulu." Tsoni wayúka mu kwenda dizakadisa ku kifulu kya tsuka.

Kaasi tangwa bákutedisi, ndawenda sikuka ku kifulu kya tsuka, ndangu mu tangwa dina kakwísa wuna kutedisiki, kakuzimbwala: "Nduku wama, tombuka ku thwala." Amana bwakála kikuma kya ngeyi lukumu ku thwala batu boosu bana bakála ku mesa ha kimosi yi ngeyi.
Kikuma, "wuna wadítombula bamukulumuna; amana wuna wadíkulumuna, bamútombula.»

Yesu wázimbula phi kwena wuna wámutedisa: «Tangwa wisi hana madya ma mu suka keti ma mu masikidika, wutedisaku banduku baku, keti baphangi baku, keti bakwa kikanda kyaku, keti bamvwama babana lwabandakana bawu; bakuvutwala nana, kilumbu kina kyakála kya bawu, hanga bakuvutwadi ngeyi phi buna wubasadidi.
Kaasi yuka ni wuzodi kuta mukinzi, tedisa baphutu yi bakwa bifu bya mutindu yi mutindu yi bifwa malu yi moku phi yi baphofu.
Wakála yi kyesi, kikuma beku yi kima bakuvutwala. Mukuma, wafútama tangwa bafútumuka batu basungama.»
Kingana kya mukinzi wa mbuta
Buna káyuka bwabuna, mosi wa batu bana bakala ku mesa wázimbula kwena Yesu: «Kyesi kwena mutu wuna wadya mu Kipfumu kya Nzambi!»
Yandi wámuvutwala: «Mutu mosi wáta mukinzi wa mbuta, amana wátedisa lawu dya batu.
Mu tangwa dya kudya, wátuma musadi wandi kenda bazimbwala batu bana kátedisa yandi: "Alwisenu! Bima byosu bya kuyidika kedi byena."
Kaasi bawu boosu, mutu yi mutu, kakala lomba ndoluka. Watheti kámuzimbwala: "Kilanga kimosi thuki mu kusumba, buluti mboti, yenda talakya; ndolula."
Mukwawu kámuzimbwala: "Bangombi kumi thuki mu kusumba, yendi bameka phi; Yikulombibwa, wandolula."
Wahika wuzimbudi: "Buthwena khwediki, pfwaniku kwisa."

Musadi, mu kuvutuka, wázimbula mambu mana kwena pfumu wandi. Hanga pfumu wa nzu, mu khabu, wuzimbudi kwena musadi wandi: "Awenda tswatsu muna mabala-bala ma mbuta keti mana ma khunda, ma mbanza, amana nata kwaku baphutu yi batu bana bena yi bifu bya lutu, mutindu yi mutindu yi bifwa mesu yi bana bisi tinguna."
Hanga kunima, musadi wisa zimbula: "Pfumu, buna wulombiki busalami, kaasi bizika bisadi hika bya khatu."
Hanga pfumu wuzimbudi kwena musadi: "Awenda muna nzila yi mu mikinda mya bilanga, balundika batu mu kukota ndangu nzu yama yabasa.
Mukuma, yiluzimbwadibwa: ka mosi ku, wa batu bana bátedisa wayédika madya ma meni."»
Abweti kukituka mulonguki wa Yesu
Milumba-lumba mya batu myakala kangala yi Yandi. Yandi wubaluki amana wubazimbwadi:

«Yuka mutu wisi kwena meni amana konda kabwisa tata wandi yi ngudi wandi yi mukhetu wandi yi bana bandi yi baphangi bandi ba bayakala yi baphangi ba bakhetu, keti luzingu lwa yandi meni, kafwaniku kukala mulonguki wa meni.
Wuna wukondi nata kitakani kyandi amana kandanda, kafwaniku kukala mulonguki wa meni.
Amana nati hana kati dya benu, wázola katunga nzu ya musyetebengi, wakonda zakala theti kikuma kya kutala ho mbongu zafwana kena zawu mu kumanisina kisalu.
Kondilo, kunima dya kusikula mupfundila, konda kalenda kumanisaya, amana bana boosu bakwisa mumona bakonda museya
mu kuzimbula: "Mutu yandu wáyandika kutunga kaasi kálendaku mu kumanisa!"
Holo, khi pfumu, yuka ni kendanwana yi pfumu wahika, kazakalaku theti mu kudihyula yuka wufwani, yi bayakala mafunda kumi, kunwanisa wuna wubati kwisa ku thwala yandi yi mafunda makumodi?
Yuka loni, buna kenina hika wuna kyana, kamútumina mbambala mu kulomba ngemba.
Yi bwabuna ni, ha kati dya benu, wuna wukondi kudibwisa yi bima byandi byosu kapfwaniku kala mulonguki wa meni.»
Mungwa wakonda mupfunu
«Mungwa kima kya mboti. Kaasi honi munzenzu wukondi, yi biki bavútwalawa?
Weku hika mboti keti kikuma kya mafu, keti kikuma kya mvumvu; bisiwa losa ku nzila. Wuna wena yi matu ma kuyuka, kayuka!»
